model_annotations.Bulgarian:
This plot illustrates the massive activation values of a baseline model across different layers, showing the maximum activation value for four different components of a transformer architecture. The x-axis represents "Layer," displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents "Max Activation Value," also on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200.

The blue dashed line with no visible markers represents "attn_output," which remains near 0 from layer 0 through approximately layer 20, then rises sharply to roughly 600 by layer 23. The orange dotted line represents "attn_residual," which stays near 0 until approximately layer 5, where it rises steeply to around 1400, then continues to increase gradually to approximately 1500–1550 through layers 6 to 20, before dropping sharply to near 0 around layer 21 and then rising again to approximately 600 by layer 23. The green dash-dot line represents "ffn_output," which remains near 0 from layer 0 to about layer 4, spikes sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, then drops back to near 0 around layer 7, rises again to roughly 400–500 between layers 13 and 15, returns to near 0 from layers 16 to 20, and then increases steeply to approximately 600 at layer 23. The red solid line represents "ffn_residual," which stays near 0 from layer 0 to approximately layer 4, rises steeply to about 1500 at layer 5, plateaus at approximately 1500–1570 from layers 6 through 20, and then drops sharply to approximately 400 around layer 22 before rising slightly toward layer 23.
